blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently encounter conflicts between internal parametric knowledge and external contextual knowledge, yet the mechanisms governing this selection remain unclear. We show that the choice between context and parametric knowledge is linearly represented and can be controlled along a single direction in the model's residual stream. We first demonstrate that this direction generalizes across factual-conflict settings, including context formats, knowledge categories, and datasets, while consistently shifting behavior between parametric and contextual answers. We then transfer a direction learned from simple factual conflicts to three more complex task families: RAG, memory, and rule following, where models must acquire information from retrieved documents, interaction histories, or explicit rules. Across four model families and multiple transfer settings, steering consistently improves the use of prompt-provided information over the unsteered model. These results suggest that the direction captures a transferable preference for external knowledge rather than a mechanism specific to factual conflicts.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)经常遇到内部参数化知识和外部背景知识之间的冲突,但指导这一选择的机制仍然不明确. 我们显示,上下文和参数化知识之间的选择是线性的,可以沿着模型剩余流的单个方向进行控制. 我们首先表明,这一方向概括了各种事实冲突背景,包括背景格式、知识类别和数据集,同时在参数和背景答案之间不断改变行为。 然后,我们将从简单的事实冲突中吸取的教训转移到三个更复杂的任务领域:RAG、内存和遵循的规则,其中模型必须从检索的文件、互动历史或明确规则中获取信息。 在4个模范家庭和多个转诊设置中,指导不断改进对快速提供信息的使用,而不是未经测试的模型。 这些结果表明,这一方向反映的是外部知识的可转移偏好,而不是针对实际冲突的一种机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Under knowledge conflicts, steering along a single residual-stream direction smoothly shifts outputs between parametric knowledge and contextual knowledge , with intermediate mixed or hesitant responses.
blocks.zh: 图1:在知识冲突下,沿着单一的残余流方向,在参数化知识和背景知识之间平稳地转变产出,并作出混合或犹豫的中间反应。

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) store a vast amount of world knowledge within their parameters, commonly referred to as parametric knowledge , enabling remarkable performance across various knowledge-intensive tasks ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Concurrently, in complex settings involving retrieved evidence, multi-turn memories, and explicit rules, LLMs must reliably acquire external contextual knowledge ( Gao et al., 2024 ) . However, these two knowledge sources often contain disparate or contradictory facts, leading to the challenge of knowledge conflict . Such conflicts frequently induce undesired behaviors, where the model indiscriminately relies on inaccurate sources and thus produces incorrect outputs ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) . Consequently, understanding the internal mechanism of how LLMs choose between conflicting knowledge sources, and achieving reliable control over this knowledge selection process, has become a critical open problem ( Zhao et al., 2025b ; Jin et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在其参数内存储了大量的世界知识,通常称为参数化知识,使得各种知识密集型任务之间能够取得显著的绩效(Wang等人,2024年). 同时,在涉及检索证据、多回合记忆和明确规则的复杂环境中,法学硕士必须可靠地获得外部背景知识(Gao等人,2024年)。 然而,这两个知识来源往往包含不同或相互矛盾的事实,导致知识冲突的挑战。 这种冲突经常引起不受欢迎的行为,即模型不分青红皂白地依赖不准确的来源,从而产生不正确的产出(徐等人,2024年;程等人,2024年)。 因此,了解LLMs如何在相互冲突的知识来源之间作出选择的内部机制,以及对这一知识选择过程的可靠控制,已成为一个严重的公开问题(Zhao等人,2025年b;Jin等人,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches address knowledge conflict primarily from two directions.
One line of work controls knowledge source choice at the input level, which can be categorized into two main approaches: explicit prompt or instruction design ( Choi et al., 2025 ; Merth et al., 2024 ) , and structured RAG templates that organize retrieved context into designated slots or label relevance ( Cattan et al., 2025 ) .
While straightforward to implement, these methods provide limited visibility into the model’s internal arbitration process and offer only indirect control over the reliance on context versus parameters.
A complementary line intervenes on internal components , including manipulating attention ( Jin et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , steering sparse autoencoder (SAE) features ( Zhao et al., 2025a ) , and modifying decoding-time token distributions ( Bi et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . These methods are primarily evaluated on simple factual datasets, without testing knowledge conflicts involving retrieved evidence, long interaction histories, or explicit rules. They also incur the cost of task-specific attribution, feature search, adaptation, or decoding-time modification, while lacking robust evaluation across such complex application settings.
blocks.zh:
现有办法主要从两个方向解决知识冲突。
一行工作控制了输入层面的知识源选择,可分为两种主要方法:明确的即时设计或指令设计(Choi等人,2025年;Merth等人,2024年),以及结构化的RAG模板,将检索的内容组织到指定的槽或标签相关性(Cattan等人,2025年).
这些方法虽然可以直接实施,但对该模型的内部仲裁程序的能见度有限,而且只能间接控制对上下文和参数的依赖。
辅助线对内部组件进行干预,包括操纵注意力(Jin等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年),引导稀疏的自动编码器(SAE)特性(Zhao等人,2025a年),以及修改解码时间符号分配. (Bi等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025a). 这些方法主要通过简单的事实数据集加以评价,没有测试涉及检索证据、长期互动历史或明确规则的知识冲突。 它们还涉及特定任务归属、特征搜索、调整或解码时间修改的费用,同时在如此复杂的应用程序设置上缺乏强有力的评价。

blocks.en:
These limitations motivate us to ask whether internal knowledge arbitration admits a simple, generalizable control mechanism.
A growing body of literature in mechanistic interpretability suggests that LLMs represent complex high-level concepts, such as truthfulness ( Li et al., 2024 ) , safety ( Wolf et al., 2025 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) , emotions ( Sofroniew et al., 2026 ) , or refusal behaviors ( Arditi et al., 2024 ) , as linear directions within their activation space ( Turner et al., 2024 ; Elhage et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2024 ) . These directions serve as causal mediators that allow fine-grained output steering. This perspective motivates the following research question: Can knowledge selection under conflict be captured and controlled by a low-dimensional steering axis that generalizes across tasks?
blocks.zh:
这些限制促使我们询问,内部知识仲裁是否承认一种简单、笼统的控制机制。
越来越多的关于机械解释的文献表明,LLMs代表着复杂的高层概念,如真实性(Li等人,2024年),安全性(Wolf等人,2025年;Zou等人,2025年),情感. (Sofroniew等人,2026年),或拒绝行为(Arditi等人,2024年),作为其激活空间内的线性方向(Turner等人,2024年;Elhage等人,2022年;Park等人,2024年). 这些指示作为因果调解者,可以对产出进行精细指导。 这一视角引发了以下研究问题: 冲突下的知识选择能否由一个贯穿各种任务的低维方向轴来捕捉和控制?

blocks.en:
In this work, we demonstrate that a robust “knowledge selection direction” exists.
Specifically, we extract this vector by contrasting the hidden states of paired prompts designed to isolate parametric reliance from contextual reliance. By identifying the critical intervention layer through cosine similarity analysis, we apply signed activation steering exclusively at this layer to modulate the model’s knowledge selection.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们表明存在着强有力的“知识选择方向”。
具体地说,我们通过对比成对电符的隐藏状态来提取这个矢量,它们旨在将参数依赖与上下文依赖隔离开来. 通过余弦相似性分析来识别关键干预层,我们专门在这个层上应用签名的激活引导来调节模型的知识选择。

blocks.en: A direction demonstrated on one factual-conflict setting may reflect a local shortcut rather than a reusable control mechanism. We evaluate across four architectures and a progression from controlled factual conflicts to complex tasks. Within the controlled setting, we vary factual format, relation category, and dataset while retaining short prompts with competing answers. We then apply the direction learned from these conflicts to RAG, memory, and rule-following tasks, where retrieved documents, multi-turn histories, and natural-language rules supply information to be acquired. Together, these experiments test whether different tasks share a common direction for acquiring input-provided knowledge. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 在一个事实冲突背景下表明的方向可能反映当地捷径,而不是可重复使用的控制机制。 我们评价了四个架构,以及从受控制的事实冲突向复杂任务的进展。 在控制环境下,我们采用不同的事实格式、关系类别和数据集,同时保留短提示和相互竞争的答案。 然后,我们将从这些冲突中学到的方向应用于RAG、内存和遵循规则的任务,在这些任务中,检索到的文件、多回合历史和自然语言规则提供了需要获取的信息。 这些实验共同检验不同的任务是否具有获得投入提供的知识的共同方向。 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • We identify a single residual-stream direction on controlled factual-conflict benchmarks that produces bidirectional, continuous control of knowledge selection across four model families. • We demonstrate that the same direction works across diverse knowledge-conflict settings, including changes in context format, knowledge category, and factual-conflict dataset. • More importantly, we show that it improves complex RAG, memory, and rule-following tasks. These improvements suggest that different task families may share an underlying direction for acquiring external knowledge.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们确定了关于受控事实冲突基准的单一剩余流程方向,从而对四个示范家庭的知识选择进行双向、持续控制。 我们表明,同一方向在不同的知识-冲突环境中发挥作用,包括在背景格式、知识类别和事实-冲突数据集方面的变化。 • 支助 更重要的是,我们显示它改善了复杂的RAG,内存,以及遵循规则的任务. 这些改进表明,不同任务家庭在获得外部知识方面可能有一个共同的基本方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Knowledge conflict arises when parametric and contextual knowledge disagree ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Mallen et al., 2023 ) . Existing interventions target attention heads ( Jin et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , SAE features ( Zhao et al., 2025a ) , or decoding ( Bi et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Our clean–conflict contrast instead models explicit source competition and enables bidirectional knowledge selection.
blocks.zh: 当参数和背景知识存在分歧时,就会产生知识冲突(徐等人,2024年;马伦等人,2023年)。 现有干预措施针对关注对象(Jin等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年),SAE特征(Zhao等人,2025年a),或解码(Bi等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a年)。 我们的干净-冲突对比相反,它树立了明确的源头竞争模式,并且能够双向选择知识。

blocks.en:
Localization-plus-intervention studies trace model behaviors to layers, heads, or neurons ( Meng et al., 2023 ; Geva et al., 2023 ) , while activation
steering modifies hidden states at inference time ( Turner et al., 2024 ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ) .
These approaches build on the view that high-level concepts can correspond to approximately
linear directions in representation space ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ; Park et al., 2024 ) . Closely related to
our setting, ( Zhang and Lin, 2026 ) argue that in-context
conflict resolution may involve angular displacement in the residual stream rather than
simple magnitude dilution. Motivated by this geometric view, we localize layers by
angular separation between paired clean and conflict prompts, and then steer along a
difference-in-means direction.

Another question is whether a direction learned from one concept captures a local shortcut or
a general behavioral axis. Prior work shows truthfulness-related directions can
generalize across datasets and causally affect outputs ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ) , but that steering
vectors can be brittle under distribution shift ( Tan et al., 2025 ) . Recent cross-model studies suggest
that concept directions can be aligned across model families ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Closest steering methods increase reliance on input information through layer search ( Anand et al., 2026 ) , proxy models ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , context-sensitivity directions ( Minder et al., 2025 ) , or instruction vectors ( Stolfo et al., 2025 ) . We test a stricter transfer: whether a direction estimated from explicit source competition generalizes to other formats, properties, and benchmarks while retaining bidirectional control.

blocks.en: 4.1 Improving Binary Source Choice

blocks.en: Table 1 first shows that Ours improves the desired source-selection rate over the unsteered model across the four models and both benchmarks, establishing control at a validation-selected operating point. blocks.en: Cross-dataset transfer. We apply the direction learned on NQ-Swap to distinct factual-conflict datasets without target-side refitting. These dataset shifts introduce variations in conflict construction, factual content, and other nuisance factors, reducing the possibility that the observed effect is tied to dataset-specific properties. Table 6 demonstrates bidirectional transfer across datasets, while context-only controls achieve consistently weaker effects.
blocks.zh: 跨数据集传输. 我们把在NQ-Swap上学到的方向应用于不同的事实冲突数据集,而不进行目标侧重排。 这些数据集的变化在冲突构造、事实内容和其他扰动因素方面带来了变化,减少了观察到的效果与数据集特定属性挂钩的可能性。 表6显示数据集之间的双向传输,而仅以上下文为主的控制效果始终较弱。

blocks.en: 5.2 To Complex, Application-Relevant Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.2 综合体,应用程序相关任务

blocks.en: We next evaluate whether a direction learned from explicit factual conflicts transfers to broader input-grounded tasks without target-task direction fitting. Unlike the controlled benchmarks, these tasks do not necessarily involve direct competition between parametric and contextual answers.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来评价从明确的事实冲突向没有目标任务方向的更广泛的投入型任务转移的方向。 与受控基准不同的是,这些任务不一定涉及参数和背景答案之间的直接竞争。

blocks.en: RAG tasks provide retrieved documents : RGB supplies deliberately counterfactual evidence, whereas CRAG uses retrieved passages that can be long, stale, noisy, or only partly relevant. Success requires selecting the supplied evidence when it conflicts with a plausible parametric answer.
blocks.zh: RAG任务提供检索到的文件 : RGB供应有意反事实证据,而CRAG则使用可检索到的段落,这些段落可能很长, Stale, 吵闹,或仅部分相关. 成功需要选择所提供的证据,如果它与一个合理的参数答案相冲突。

blocks.en: Memory tasks provide multi-turn histories . In LoCoMo, LoCoMo-Plus, and LongMemEval, the relevant fact may lie many turns from the question and compete with a continuation, stale association, or another event. These tasks test retrieval, localization, and temporal ordering of knowledge rather than passage matching.
blocks.zh: 内存任务提供多回合历史. 在LoCoMo,LoCoMo-Plus和LongMemEval中,相关事实可能与问题的许多转折相冲突,并与一个延续性,僵化的协会或另一个事件竞争. 这些任务测试了知识的检索,本地化,以及时间顺序而不是通过匹配.

blocks.en: Rule-following tasks provide explicit behavioral constraints . IFEval and FollowBench require the model to retain rules about output structure, length, required content, and exclusions throughout generation; they serve as instruction-following controls for whether the direction improves use of contextual constraints.
blocks.zh: 遵循规则的任务提供了明确的行为约束。 IFEval 和 Follow Bench 要求该模型保留关于产出结构、长度、所需内容和整个世代的排除的规则;它们充当指导跟踪控制,用于控制方向是否改进对背景限制的使用。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We show that a single residual-stream direction enables smooth, bidirectional selection between parametric knowledge and external context. Changing its signed coefficient at one carefully selected layer shifts both aggregate source-match rates and fixed-instance responses.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,单一的残余流方向能够在参数化知识和外部背景之间进行平稳、双向的选择。 在一个仔细选择的层次上改变其签字系数,既会改变总的源对比率,也会改变固定的响应。

blocks.en: The control generalizes across conflict formats, factual relations, and datasets, and transfers to RAG, multi-turn memory, and rule-following tasks without target-task direction fitting. Weaker context-attention controls suggest that transfer reflects source competition. These results provide evidence for a transferable control direction underlying knowledge-source selection.
blocks.zh: 控制概括了冲突格式、事实关系和数据集,并向RAG、多回合内存和遵循规则的任务转移,而不适应目标任务方向。 疲软的上下文注意控制表明,转让反映了源的竞争。 这些结果为知识源选择所依据的可转移控制方向提供了证据。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
First, our method requires white-box access to model activations.
Since the direction is estimated and applied in the residual stream, it is not directly applicable to closed-source or API-only models.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们的方法需要白箱访问模型激活。
由于方向是估计并应用于剩余流,因此它并不直接适用于闭源型或只应用API型.

blocks.en:
Second, the learned direction should be viewed as a useful control axis rather than a complete mechanism of knowledge selection.
Although a single direction enables effective steering, source selection may still involve broader circuits, including attention heads, MLP features, and decoding dynamics.
blocks.zh:
第二,应把所了解的方向视为有用的控制轴,而不是选择知识的完整机制。
虽然单一方向可以有效引导,但源选择仍可能涉及更广泛的电路,包括注意力头,MLP特征,以及解码动态.

blocks.en:
Third, our evaluation is based mainly on controlled factual-conflict benchmarks and source-choice accuracy.
This setup isolates parametric versus contextual reliance, but may not capture more nuanced outputs such as hedging, partial agreement, or answers that combine both sources.
blocks.zh:
第三,我们的评价主要基于受控制的事实冲突基准和来源选择的准确性。
这种设置隔离了参数与上下文的依赖,但可能无法捕捉到更细微的输出,如套期保值,部分协议,或结合两种来源的答案.

blocks.en: Finally, the direction improves the complex tasks we evaluate, but the gains are often smaller than in controlled factual conflicts and depend on the underlying capabilities of each model. Establishing how model competence, task difficulty, and evidence quality jointly determine these effects remains future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,方向改进了我们评价的复杂任务,但收益往往比受控制的事实冲突少,并取决于每个模式的基本能力。 确定示范能力、任务困难和证据质量如何共同确定这些影响仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Details

blocks.en:
We briefly describe how each benchmark is converted into our source-choice setting.
For all datasets, we first keep examples where the model answers the clean prompt correctly. We then evaluate the same examples under a conflict prompt that supports an alternative answer.
The original answer is treated as the parametric answer, while the answer supported by the conflict prompt is treated as the contextual answer.
Prompt examples are provided in Appendix H .
blocks.zh:
我们简要描述每个基准是如何转换成源选择的。
对于所有数据集,我们首先保留模型正确回答干净的提示的例子. 然后,我们在一个支持替代答案的冲突提示下评价同样的例子。
最初的答案作为参数答案处理,而冲突提示支持的答案则作为背景答案处理.
附录H提供了迅速的例子。

blocks.en:
NQ-Swap pairs Natural Questions examples with substituted passages.
We use the original answer as the parametric answer and the substituted answer as the contextual answer.
The clean prompt contains only the question, while the conflict prompt prepends the substituted context before the same question.
We use the question-deduplicated split without tables or list items.
blocks.zh:
NQ-Swap 配对 自然问题实例与替换段落.
我们使用原始答案作为参数化答案,替代答案作为上下文答案。
干净的提示只包含问题,而冲突提示将替换的上下文放在同一问题之前。
我们使用不使用表格或列表项目而重复的问题划分。

blocks.en:
MacNoise provides QA examples with perturbed retrieved contexts.
The original answer is used as the parametric answer, and the replacement answer is used as the contextual answer.
For each example, we select the first perturbed context marked by pert_lbls_100 == 1 and prepend its text_pert field to form the conflict prompt.
blocks.zh:
MacNoise提供了带有扰动检索上下文的QA实例.
原始答案作为参数解答,替换答案作为上下文解答.
对于每个例子,我们选择第一个扰动的上下文 标记为pert_lbls_100 == 1 并预置其文本_ pert 字段以形成冲突提示 。

blocks.en:
ParaConflict contains synthetic factual conflicts across multiple categories.
The gold answer is treated as the parametric answer, and the distracted token is treated as the contextual answer.
We use the coherent conflict format in the main experiments because it provides a natural-language passage supporting the distractor.
For cross-format transfer, we train on substitution-format items and evaluate on coherent-format items.
blocks.zh:
帕拉冲突包含跨多个类别合成的事实冲突。
金答作为参数解答,分心符作为上下文解答.
我们在主要实验中使用了连贯的冲突格式,因为它提供了一个支持分心者的自然语言通道.
对于跨格式转让,我们进行替代格式项目的培训,并对统一格式的项目进行评价。

blocks.en:
CounterFact contains factual editing examples grouped by Wikidata relation.
The true target is treated as the parametric answer, and the edited target is treated as the contextual answer.
The conflict prompt is constructed by inserting the edited target into a paraphrased prefix and appending the original factual query.
For cross-knowledge-type transfer, we evaluate six relations: country of citizenship, manufacturer, occupation, religion, sport, and original broadcaster.

FoundationFact包含按Wikidata关系分类的事实编辑实例.
真目标作为参数解答处理,编辑后的目标作为上下文解答处理.
冲突提示的构建方式是将编辑的目标插入到一个解释性前缀中,并附加原始的事实查询.
对于跨知识类型的转让,我们评价了六种关系:国籍国、制造商、职业、宗教、体育和原播音员。

blocks.en:
MemoTrap creates conflicts between memorized phrase completions and explicit prompt instructions.
The familiar phrase continuation is treated as the parametric answer, while the instruction-satisfying completion is treated as the contextual answer.
The clean prompt removes the explicit ending constraint, whereas the conflict prompt keeps the original instruction.
blocks.zh:
MemoTrap在记忆的短语完成和明确的即时指令之间产生冲突.
熟悉的短语续作作为参数解答,而指令-满意完成则作为上下文解答.
干净的提示消除了明确的结束约束,而冲突提示则保留了原来的指令.

blocks.en: RGB supplies retrieved, deliberately counterfactual passages whose answer conflicts with a familiar factual answer; we evaluate whether the output follows the supplied evidence. CRAG supplies retrieved web-style passages for factual questions, including cases with stale, competing, noisy, or partially relevant evidence. We use each benchmark’s held-out evaluation items and its factual source-match protocol.
blocks.zh: RGB用品检索到的,故意反事实的段落,其答案与熟悉的事实答案相冲突;我们评价产出是否遵循所提供的证据。 CRAG为事实问题提供了检索到的网络式段落,包括有陈旧、相互竞争、吵闹或部分相关证据的案件。 我们使用每个基准的搁置评价项目及其真实的源对协议。

blocks.en: These datasets require answers grounded in multi-turn personal histories. LoCoMo and LoCoMo-Plus test retrieval and linkage across earlier dialogue turns, while LongMemEval additionally stresses temporal ordering and aggregation across events. We preserve each benchmark’s native held-out split and exact-match evaluator.
blocks.zh: 这些数据集需要基于多回合个人历史的答案. LoCoMo和LoCoMo-Plus测试检索和连接到先前的对话框,而LongMemEval则额外强调跨事件的时间顺序和聚合。 我们保留每个基准的本地持有和精确匹配的评价员。

blocks.en: These instruction-following datasets specify explicit requirements on output structure, length, content, or lexical exclusions. We use their native constraint-compliance evaluators; they serve as controls for retaining and applying external instructions across the generated response.
blocks.zh: 这些遵循指令的数据集具体规定了对输出结构,长度,内容,或词典排除的明确要求. 我们使用其本地的制约遵守情况评价员;这些评价员是在整个生成的反应中保留和适用外部指示的控制人员。

blocks.en: C.3 Match Rules
blocks.zh: C.3 匹配规则

blocks.en:
Let s s be the normalized 256-token answer window. The four labels below are mutually exclusive and exhaustive; both/neither outputs are retained in the denominator rather than discarded. • Parametric-only : s s contains a par a_{\mathrm{par}} as a substring, or an alias thereof, and does not contain a ctx a_{\mathrm{ctx}} . • Contextual-only : s s contains a ctx a_{\mathrm{ctx}} and does not contain a par a_{\mathrm{par}} . • Both : s s contains both answers. • Neither : s s contains neither answer, or the output is empty/refusal/off-topic. Long answers are handled by substring search within the normalized answer window only; tokens after position 256 are not searched.
This operational metric measures answer-string source matching, not full semantic entailment; Appendix C.5 therefore describes the benchmark-native semantic or constraint evaluators used for complex tasks.

blocks.en: String matching permits deterministic, low-cost evaluation across the full alpha sweep. To audit its construct validity, we sample 100 OOD outputs per dataset. blocks.en: C.5 Complex-Task Evaluators
blocks.zh: C.5 复杂任务评价员

blocks.en: For each model, all complex-task experiments use its direction learned on NQ-Swap, injected at that model’s selected layer with coefficients fixed from NQ-Swap validation; no target-task direction, coefficient, or layer is estimated or relocalized. For each task, all coefficients are evaluated on the same deterministic sample subset, and we report the mean official per-item score times 100. These downstream scores assess input-grounded behavior: except for RGB, a correct output alone does not establish whether the unsteered error arose from factual priors, evidence localization, reasoning, or response generation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型,所有复杂任务实验都使用它在NQ-Swap上学到的方向,在NQ-Swap的选定层注入系数,从NQ-Swap验证中固定;没有目标任务方向,系数,或层被估算或重新定位. 对于每一项任务,所有系数都在同一决定性样本子集上进行评估,我们报告每个项目的平均官方得分乘以100。 这些下游分数评估了输入基于的行为:除了RGB之外,仅一个正确的输出并不能确定未触发的错误是否来自事实前科,证据本地化,推理,或响应生成.

blocks.en: We evaluate at most 500 processed items per task, sampling without replacement with seed 43 when a pool exceeds 500 items; smaller pools are evaluated in full. The model receives only the task-supplied context, and credit is assigned against the contextual target or benchmark constraint. Thus, complex-task scores do not use the 256-token source-match protocol above.

blocks.en: RGB contains 100 counterfactual retrieval items. blocks.en:
We further examine whether the same one-dimensional steering behavior holds for larger instruction-tuned models.

blocks.en: This audit classifies baseline context-conflict errors that an available positive- α \alpha sweep changed into an officially correct output. Here, knowledge conflict is used broadly: a model default (factual prior, continuation, event ordering, or output habit) can conflict with information or constraints supplied by the context. The alpha shown for each example is the first observed correct positive-alpha output, not an item-level selection rule. “Parametric knowledge” is an inference from the baseline text, not a claim about an unobserved model state. We use three mechanism labels: P for an explicit override of supplied evidence by a real-world or general-knowledge correction; L for missed, misordered, or underspecified supplied context; and I for a requested format or constraint that the context requires.

blocks.en: I.1 Cross-Format Transfer
blocks.zh: I.1 跨格式转让

blocks.en:
ParaConflict provides substitution and coherent conflict formats for the same questions, as described in the transfer setup.
Figure 9 supplements the main-text results by showing cross-format transfer for the remaining three models.
Across models, steering generally improves the selection of the intended knowledge source in most categories, indicating that the learned direction transfers across formats rather than being tied to a specific surface template.
blocks.zh:
Para Country为同样的问题提供了替代和连贯的冲突形式,如转移设置中描述的那样.
图9通过显示其余三个模型的跨格式传输来补充主文本结果.
在整个模型中,指导一般改进了大多数类别中预定知识来源的选择,表明学到的方向在格式之间转移,而不是与特定的表面模板挂钩。

blocks.en:
Figure 9: Cross-format transfer on ParaConflict for the remaining three models.
Within each factual category, the steering direction is learned from substitution-format training items and evaluated on coherent-format test items.
Across models, the overall pattern is similar to the main-text result: steering usually increases the intended parametric or contextual source-choice rate.
blocks.zh:
图9:其余三种模式的Para Country跨格式转让。
在每个事实类别中,指导方向都从替代格式培训项目中学习,并按统一格式测试项目加以评价。
在整个模型中,总体模式与主文本结果相似:引导通常会提高预期的参数或上下文源选择率.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Cross-knowledge-type transfer on CounterFact for the remaining three models. Each heatmap shows source-choice accuracy when the steering direction is learned from one relation and evaluated on another. Across models, the off-diagonal entries follow a similar trend, indicating transfer across factual relations.

blocks.en: I.3 Cross-Dataset Transfer
blocks.zh: I.3 跨数据集传输

blocks.en:
We report additional cross-dataset transfer results for the remaining three models in Tables 22 , 23 , and 24 .
Following the main-text setup, the steering direction and coefficients are selected only on NQ-Swap and then directly applied to other test datasets without target-specific tuning.
Across models, steering generally improves both Acc par and Acc ctx , further supporting that the learned direction captures a transferable knowledge-selection signal rather than overfitting to a single dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们报告表22、23和24中其余三个模型的额外跨数据集传输结果。
在主文字设置之后,方向和系数只选择在NQ-Swap上,然后直接应用到其他测试数据集,而不进行目标特定的调试.
在整个模型中,指导一般都改进了Acc par和Acc ctx,进一步支持学习方向捕捉到一个可转移的知识选择信号,而不是过度适应一个数据集。
